Explore Careers Within Careers Search Jobs Early Careers Culture, Values, and Inclusion Experienced Professionals Locations Events Climate Change and Sustainability Nature-Based Solutions Companies are increasingly looking to adopt comprehensive environmental strategies, including nature-based solutions, to address their full value chain impact. We help companies create nature-positive strategies and integrate nature-based solutions that drive value creation and build supply chain resilience. The planet’s ecological biodiversity provides vital services, including climate regulation, water storage and filtration, and air purification. And what is the estimated value of those resources? In excess of $150 trillion annually. Yet, human activity continues to endanger the natural world. We are in the midst of Earth’s sixth mass extinction event, with one-fifth of the world’s countries now at risk of ecosystem collapse. Forward-looking companies understand that there is a compelling business case for building a nature-positive operation, finding synergies between climate efforts, and reducing the environmental impact of business. Subscribe The Sustainable Advantage: Build lasting impact through sustainability The Sustainable Advantage: Build lasting impact through sustainability You are subscribed to BCG's The Sustainable Advantage newsletter. Manage Subscriptions Subscribe Our Approach to Nature-Positive Strategy and Nature-Based Solutions Nature and climate are inextricably linked; loss of ecological biodiversity exacerbates climate change. And nature-based solutions will play a critical role in capturing and reducing atmospheric carbon and enhancing adaptation and resilience. BCG helps companies understand the environmental impact of business and build comprehensive environmental strategies that align business priorities with planetary boundaries . This includes designing a holistic nature-positive strategy that addresses businesses’ contribution to deforestation, plastic pollution, and more: Expand All 1. Define the Nature-Positive Strategy and Ambition We help companies assess their footprint when it comes to impacts on nature, set targets, and build a roadmap to integrate nature activities with their climate plans. 2. Make the Core Sustainable We work with companies to build nature-positive supply chains and sustainable operations and, when possible, deploy nature-based solutions for biodiversity restoration and the regeneration of natural ecosystems. 3. Driving New Sustainable Growth A nature-positive strategy is not only a means to reduce risk but also a way to build new businesses. We help clients seize those opportunities, including via new green ventures and deep tech. We also work with them to adopt new sustainable business models, including circularity, to produce more with fewer natural resources. 4. Enabling the Transformation We work with companies to build the foundation for a successful nature-positive transformation, including creating the right operating model, governance, data strategy, and capabilities. Our Clients’ Success in Nature-Based Solutions Client Impact Cheaper, Faster, Cleaner: Mining Reinvented by Nature By harnessing nature’s genetic machinery, Genomines replaces mines with farms—delivering critical metals at scale while slashing costs, emissions, and timelines. A revolution in global mineral extraction has begun. Learn More Client Impact Fighting Climate Change with Family Forests BCG is helping American Forest Foundation scale up a nature-based carbon credit program and deliver 1 billion tons of climate impact by 2050. Learn More Client Impact Transforming Burgo Group into an ESG Leader BCG helped define ambitious decarbonization targets and chart a path toward greater sustainability. Learn More Our Nature-Positive Partnerships The Future Depends on a Resilient Blue Economy Learn More In this film, BCG and the Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping explore how the maritime sector must merge sustainability with competitiveness. Collaboration and partnerships are key. World Wildlife Fund (WWF) Learn More BCG launched a global partnership with WWF in 2012, working with the organization on numerous projects—globally, regionally, and locally. We worked closely with WWF in the lead-up to COP15 to advocate for an ambitious global agreement on nature. Our work supports WWF’s mission to stop the degradation of the planet’s natural environment and build a future in which people live in harmony with nature. Science-Based Targets Network (SBTN) BCG has partnered with SBTN to support the organization’s efforts to develop science-based targets for nature. Our support includes establishing governance and processes to ensure effective work with multiple stakeholders.             <section class="collapsible-list-item collapsible-content__details">

                <details id="detail_00000191-8017-d432-a3d1-a07f905b0003__0"  class="collapsible-content__detail">
                    <summary>
                        <div class="tabs-item-heading">
                            <svg class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#plus" /></svg>
                            <svg class="minus" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#minus" /></svg>
                            <span>Understand AI in Cost Management</span>
                        </div>
                    </summary>

                    <div class="tabs-item-content">
                        

<div class="CollapsibleListItem" data-no-media>

    <div class="Promo-content">
        <div class="Promo-description">For many leaders, understanding AI in cost management is new territory, yet AI is already changing how companies operate, make decisions, and structure costs. The real challenge is not the algorithm. Adoption, behavior change, and redesigned ways of working are what amplify results and translate AI into measurable P&L impact. With expertise gained from hundreds of AI engagements, BCG helps enterprises accelerate progress during their entire AI journey:<br><ul columns="2"><li><b>10-20-70. </b>Technology, data, and behavioral change work together to unlock value at scale with <a class="LinkWithIcon"href="https://www.bcg.com/featured-insights/the-leaders-guide-to-transforming-with-ai"data-path="the-leaders-guide-to-transforming-with-ai">BCG’s 10-20-70 approach</a>: 10% of the project is algorithms, 20% is technology and data, and 70% is focused on people, processes, and behavior, to amplify impact and sustain cost advantage.</li><li><b>Deploy–Reshape–Invent. </b>AI impact builds in stages. Deploying off-the-shelf AI solutions leads to immediate productivity gains. Reshaping complex, high-cost core functions boosts structural efficiency by 30% to 50%. And reinventing business models delivers the most transformative results and long-term differentiation.</li></ul></div>
    </div>

</div>


                    </div>
                </details>

            </section> 
        
            <section class="collapsible-list-item collapsible-content__details">

                <details id="detail_00000191-8017-d432-a3d1-a07f905b0003__1"  class="collapsible-content__detail">
                    <summary>
                        <div class="tabs-item-heading">
                            <svg class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#plus" /></svg>
                            <svg class="minus" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#minus" /></svg>
                            <span>Create Leaner, Faster, Stronger Companies </span>
                        </div>
                    </summary>

                    <div class="tabs-item-content">
                        

<div class="CollapsibleListItem" data-no-media>

    <div class="Promo-content">
        <div class="Promo-description">Unlike isolated cost reduction or restructuring plans, our approach to cost advantage uses AI-powered cost optimization solutions to amplify efficiency and accelerate value creation.<br><ul columns="2"><li><b>Leaner.</b> We help leaders do more with less. Applying decades of expertise, we identify where and how to reduce costs, convert fixed costs to variable costs, and improve efficiency.AI amplifies our ability to pinpoint opportunity and prioritize initiatives based on ROI, ensuring maximum value capture and sustained impact, underpinned by our industry-leading change management approach. </li><li><b>Faster.</b> Our battle-tested cost strategy accelerates speed-to-value by establishing empowered, proactive program leadership that drives a consistent operational tempo across an enterprise. Bureaucratic roadblocks are replaced with rigorous governance and accountability, facilitating timely and thorough execution to accelerate cost reduction. AI enhances visibility and decision cycles, helping organizations move with precision while maintaining accountability.</li><li><b>Stronger.</b> Sustainable cost advantage comes from embedding change, not just installing tools. Most of the value in AI-enabled cost transformation depends on adoption, redesigned processes, and new ways of working. We help organizations translate technology into everyday behavior so efficiency gains take root, capabilities compound, and performance strengthens over time. </li></ul></div>
    </div>

</div>


                    </div>
                </details>

            </section> 
        
            <section class="collapsible-list-item collapsible-content__details">

                <details id="detail_00000191-8017-d432-a3d1-a07f905b0003__2"  class="collapsible-content__detail">
                    <summary>
                        <div class="tabs-item-heading">
                            <svg class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#plus" /></svg>
                            <svg class="minus" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#minus" /></svg>
                            <span>Apply the Full Range of Capabilities</span>
                        </div>
                    </summary>

                    <div class="tabs-item-content">
                        

<div class="CollapsibleListItem" data-no-media>

    <div class="Promo-content">
        <div class="Promo-description">We bring extensive expertise to support strategic cost management transformations:<br><ul columns="2"><li><a class="LinkWithIcon"href="https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/artificial-intelligence"data-path="artificial-intelligence"><b>AI.</b></a> We help clients harness the power of traditional and generative AI to capitalize on near-term cost optimization opportunities while accelerating productivity across functions. Our powerful tool stack combines proven diagnostic tools with advanced AI solutions that deliver rapid, measurable results.  </li><li><a class="LinkWithIcon"href="https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/operations/end-to-end-operational-excellence"data-path="end-to-end-operational-excellence"><b>Operational Excellence.</b></a> Transforming the value chain enhances service and quality, reduces costs, and mitigates risks—amplifying efficiency. </li><li><a class="LinkWithIcon"href="https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/organization-strategy/organization-design"data-path="organization-design"><b>Organization Design.</b></a> A cost advantage program succeeds when structure, roles, and incentives align to sustain impact.</li><li><a class="LinkWithIcon"href="https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/pricing-revenue-management/overview"data-path="overview"><b>Pricing and Revenue Management.</b></a> By optimizing marketing investment and establishing disciplined pricing strategy, we help companies amplify bottom-line impact. </li><li><a class="LinkWithIcon"href="https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/digital-technology-data/tech-function"data-path="tech-function"><b>Technology Cost Optimization.</b></a> We transform IT into a cost-efficient, strategic partner, accelerating digital capability and simplification.</li><li><a class="LinkWithIcon"href="https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/zero-based-budgeting/overview"data-path="overview"><b>Zero-Based Budgeting.</b></a> More than deploying one-time cost-reduction strategies, our approach to zero-based budgeting uses facts to decide how to liberate resources and make smart choices about where to allocate them. This approach is rooted in a culture of cost consciousness. </li></ul></div>
    </div>

</div>


                    </div>
                </details>

            </section>

        <div class="Promo-description">Strategic cost management requires unlocking short- and long-term savings. AI amplifies our approach, delivering both speed and value:<br><ol class="rte2-style-ol" id="rte-d5f35030-167a-11f1-8c65-55688651edfb" start="1"><li><b>Provide a roadmap for taking out costs (4–6 weeks).</b> We size cost-reduction opportunities that align with our clients’ overarching strategic goals and establish initiatives to realize value.  </li><li><b>Capture near-term wins and design long-term initiatives (12–18 weeks).</b> We help our clients realize real value quickly and lay the groundwork for longer-term cost-transformation initiatives. AI accelerates diagnostics and execution, acting as a force multiplier grounded in disciplined change management. </li><li><b>Implement longer-term wins (6–12 months).</b> To promote sustained value, we launch cost-transformation initiatives tied to long-term strategic goals and establish processes to ensure continuous cost management. </li></ol></div>

BCG combines proven cost optimization capabilities with AI expertise to deliver enduring competitive advantage. Strategic cost management is about making savings stick. AI-enabled cost management solutions amplify and accelerate cost programs—fueling innovation, resilience, and growth. BCG integrates cost management strategy with AI at scale to help leaders enhance their ability to win without having to repeat the same cost reduction effort every few years. Subscribe Stay ahead with BCG insights on cost management Stay ahead with BCG insights on cost management You are subscribed to BCG's eAlert on cost management. Manage Subscriptions Subscribe Our Approach to Cost Management Strategy BCG takes a customized, industry-specific approach to cost transformation. Our cost advantage experts look across the organization, evaluating how companies can reduce or eliminate costs and reinvest savings for long-term growth. We use artificial intelligence as a force multiplier to reduce costs by automating processes, increasing transparency, and accelerating workflows. Our AI-powered cost optimization solutions scale transformation and track value in real time—shortening execution timelines by up to 18 months. How AI Powers Cost Optimization Transparency Innovative Workflows Work Optimization Structural Advantage Adaptive Learning Transparency Transparency Deliver real-time insights into cost drivers in traditionally hard-to-track areas such as third-party spend Innovative Workflows Innovative Workflows Drastically simplify processes and enhance cross-team collaboration to boost organizational agility Work Optimization Work Optimization Implement scalable transformation through automating tasks and decision making Structural Advantage Structural Advantage Dramatically boost productivity, leading to a lower cost base and long-term competitiveness Adaptive Learning Adaptive Learning Continuously learn from data, feedback, and interactions, improving performance of the decision-making process over time How We Help Clients with Cost Management Expand All Understand AI in Cost Management For many leaders, understanding AI in cost management is new territory, yet AI is already changing how companies operate, make decisions, and structure costs. The real challenge is not the algorithm. Adoption, behavior change, and redesigned ways of working are what amplify results and translate AI into measurable P&L impact. With expertise gained from hundreds of AI engagements, BCG helps enterprises accelerate progress during their entire AI journey: 10-20-70. Technology, data, and behavioral change work together to unlock value at scale with BCG’s 10-20-70 approach : 10% of the project is algorithms, 20% is technology and data, and 70% is focused on people, processes, and behavior, to amplify impact and sustain cost advantage. Deploy–Reshape–Invent. AI impact builds in stages. Deploying off-the-shelf AI solutions leads to immediate productivity gains. Reshaping complex, high-cost core functions boosts structural efficiency by 30% to 50%. And reinventing business models delivers the most transformative results and long-term differentiation. Create Leaner, Faster, Stronger Companies Unlike isolated cost reduction or restructuring plans, our approach to cost advantage uses AI-powered cost optimization solutions to amplify efficiency and accelerate value creation. Leaner. We help leaders do more with less. Applying decades of expertise, we identify where and how to reduce costs, convert fixed costs to variable costs, and improve efficiency.AI amplifies our ability to pinpoint opportunity and prioritize initiatives based on ROI, ensuring maximum value capture and sustained impact, underpinned by our industry-leading change management approach. Faster. Our battle-tested cost strategy accelerates speed-to-value by establishing empowered, proactive program leadership that drives a consistent operational tempo across an enterprise. Bureaucratic roadblocks are replaced with rigorous governance and accountability, facilitating timely and thorough execution to accelerate cost reduction. AI enhances visibility and decision cycles, helping organizations move with precision while maintaining accountability. Stronger. Sustainable cost advantage comes from embedding change, not just installing tools. Most of the value in AI-enabled cost transformation depends on adoption, redesigned processes, and new ways of working. We help organizations translate technology into everyday behavior so efficiency gains take root, capabilities compound, and performance strengthens over time. Apply the Full Range of Capabilities We bring extensive expertise to support strategic cost management transformations: AI. We help clients harness the power of traditional and generative AI to capitalize on near-term cost optimization opportunities while accelerating productivity across functions. Our powerful tool stack combines proven diagnostic tools with advanced AI solutions that deliver rapid, measurable results. Operational Excellence. Transforming the value chain enhances service and quality, reduces costs, and mitigates risks—amplifying efficiency. Organization Design. A cost advantage program succeeds when structure, roles, and incentives align to sustain impact. Pricing and Revenue Management. By optimizing marketing investment and establishing disciplined pricing strategy, we help companies amplify bottom-line impact. Technology Cost Optimization. We transform IT into a cost-efficient, strategic partner, accelerating digital capability and simplification. Zero-Based Budgeting. More than deploying one-time cost-reduction strategies, our approach to zero-based budgeting uses facts to decide how to liberate resources and make smart choices about where to allocate them. This approach is rooted in a culture of cost consciousness. Deliver Value Rapidly Strategic cost management requires unlocking short- and long-term savings. AI amplifies our approach, delivering both speed and value: Provide a roadmap for taking out costs (4–6 weeks). We size cost-reduction opportunities that align with our clients’ overarching strategic goals and establish initiatives to realize value. Capture near-term wins and design long-term initiatives (12–18 weeks). We help our clients realize real value quickly and lay the groundwork for longer-term cost-transformation initiatives. AI accelerates diagnostics and execution, acting as a force multiplier grounded in disciplined change management. Implement longer-term wins (6–12 months). To promote sustained value, we launch cost-transformation initiatives tied to long-term strategic goals and establish processes to ensure continuous cost management.
